title: Every agent writes the context in the chat before it asks — never 'read it on the board'
description: Add one explicit rule wherever the agent asks the human something: before any question for decide, approve or accept, write the full context in this conversation — the decision's options with reason and costLater, or the whole approach and every acceptance criterion, or the review findings. Never replace it with a pointer to the board, the dashboard or `sober` CLI; the board is a second copy, not the only one. Sources: plugins/skills/{decide,brief,next,plan,loop}/SKILL.md (edit the source, then `pnpm plugins` regenerates packages/*-plugin skills), the server instructions in packages/mcp/src/index.ts:29, and the decide/approve/accept descriptions in packages/mcp/src/tools/plan.ts and review.ts. Under tool-renders/both, the rule says 'paste the block the tool returned'. Test: a check (in the existing plugin build/drift test) that each of those skills contains the rule sentence; `pnpm plugins` leaves no diff.
